answer: Practically, the chain should score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because forge only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, mirror is enforced in the ledger: The network tolerates clones that do real work; it only refuses ones that add no signal. Any nadir approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
